name: Honest adult, not revoked
note: accepted, as it must be (otherwise the lab would prove nothing)

name: Replay a captured proof at a different verifier
note: proof is bound to the first verifier's nonce

name: Replay the same proof at the same verifier
note: needs verifier-side single-use nonces (an application duty)

name: Self-issued credential from a rogue issuer
note: pairing check e(A',w)=e(Abar,g2) fails under the real issuer key

name: Tamper with a disclosed attribute
note: disclosed value is part of the proven statement

name: Claim an attribute the issuer never signed (CGPA 10.0)
note: no valid signature exists for the altered attribute vector

name: Splice an adult's birth date into a minor's credential
note: mix-and-match across credentials breaks the signature

name: Degenerate points (A' = A-bar = infinity)
note: verifier rejects A' = identity (it would pass the pairing check trivially)

name: Malleate the proof (change one response scalar)
Minor tries to prove age >= 18 honestly
note: prover cannot even build the proof (difference is negative)

name: Minor wraps a negative difference around 2^32
note: bits sum to 2^32-5, not -5, so the sum check fails

name: Swap the birth-date commitment for one to a different value
note: commitment no longer matches the value the issuer signed

name: Minor proves a weaker predicate than the verifier asked for
Revoked holder tries to present
note: no inverse of (handle - handle) exists, so no proof can be built

name: Present against a stale (pre-revocation) blacklist
note: proof is bound to the exact list; the verifier's list is newer

name: Strip own handle out of the blacklist before proving
note: statements are rebuilt from the verifier's own list

name: Colluding verifiers try to link presentations of the same holder
note: VeilCred: 0 linkable pairs; naive 'show the signature' baseline: 6/6 same-holder pairs linked. (Disclosed attributes can still link if they are identifying.)
